definition: the inner surface of the hand
description: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.

en.question: What is the woman in front doing?

de.answer: Sie wärmt ihre Handflächen am Feuer.
de.question: Was macht die Frau vorne?

es.answer: Se está calentando las palmas de las manos junto al fuego.
